article.title: Modellix接入ComfyUI，讓圖像、影片與音訊串成工作流程
article.title_en: Modellix brings image, video and audio models into ComfyUI workflows
article.summary: Aurora Mobile於10月30日公布Modellix.ai的ComfyUI整合。
article.summary_en: Aurora Mobile announced Modellix.ai’s ComfyUI integration on October 30.
highlights: 可用既有API金鑰選取模型及設定參數。
支援非同步生成與取回既有任務。
highlights_en: Existing API keys connect models and parameters.
Asynchronous generation and existing-task retrieval are supported.
article.why: 製作團隊可把不同媒體步驟存成可重用流程，方便交接。
article.why_en: Production teams can hand over reusable workflows across media steps.
article.next_step: 先試一個短流程，檢查任務取回及每次生成的收費。
article.next_step_en: Test a short workflow, checking task recovery and generation charges.
article.detail: ComfyUI以視覺化節點連接製作步驟。按Aurora Mobile公告，Modellix可在同一流程選取圖像、影片及音訊模型，加入媒體輸入，再把結果送到預覽或儲存節點。範例亦包括語音及任務取回。這是接入方式的公告，並不表示模型在本機運行、免費使用或已取得素材商用授權；團隊仍需核對模型與平台條款。
article.detail_en: ComfyUI connects production steps through visual nodes. Modellix sends generated media to native preview or save nodes; examples include speech and task recovery. Integration does not mean local inference, free generation or cleared commercial rights. Check model and platform terms.
